why: min/max/step as three scalars. rclrs's `range()` takes a `T::Range` VALUE, and we have that method too (it matched) -- but a facade user cannot construct the value to pass it, because `ParameterRange`/`IntegerRange`/`FloatingPointRange` are not re-exported (see `rust:ParameterRange`). So the scalar form is currently the only reachable one. If the facade gap is closed this stops earning its place.
